::: {.callout-note title="How to use this roadmap"}
Follow the units and modules in order. Each section states what students will learn or do, what equipment, software, and consumables are needed, what students submit, and any useful teacher notes.
:::

The sequence is a planning guide. Adjust individual activities to the available equipment and the students in the class.

## Full progression

- [0. Course Orientation, Safety, Design Process, and Documentation](#unit-0)
- [1. Number Systems, Measurement, Units, and Calculator Skills](#unit-1)
- [2. Electricity, Charge, Voltage, Current, Resistance, Power, and Energy](#unit-2)
- [3. DC Circuit Analysis](#unit-3)
- [4. Breadboarding, Schematics, Simulation, and Measurement](#unit-4)
- [5. Electronic Components and Applied Circuits](#unit-5)
- [6. Digital Logic and Stable Inputs](#unit-6)
- [7. Fabrication and PCB Workflow](#unit-7)
- [8. Basic Computer Systems](#unit-8)
- [9. Linux and Operating Systems](#unit-9)
- [10. Programming Fundamentals](#unit-10)
- [11. Microcontrollers and Physical Computing](#unit-11)
- [12. Networking and Systems Administration](#unit-12)
- [13. Data Science and Machine Learning](#unit-13)
- [14. Language Models and Applied AI](#unit-14)
- [15. Culminating Projects](#unit-15)
- [16. Bonus Pathway - Control Systems and CNC](#unit-16)

<div data-tej-roadmap>

## 3. DC Circuit Analysis {#unit-3}

<div class="tej-roadmap-unit-summary">
<p>Analyze series, parallel, and mixed DC circuits with Ohm&#x27;s law, KCL, KVL, dividers, equivalent resistance, and fault reasoning.</p>

| What is needed | Unit overview |
|:--|:--|
| Equipment | breadboards, protected DC sources, DMMs, resistor kits |
| Software | Tinkercad Circuits |
| Consumables | resistors, LEDs, hookup wire, replaceable protective fuses |
| Student deliverables | GUESS calculations, schematics, simulations, measured comparisons, fault diagnosis |
| Teacher notes | Teach series first, parallel second, and mixed circuits only after students can explain and verify both rule sets. |

[Public notes](../02-basic-electronics/index.qmd)
</div>

| Software | Tinkercad Circuits, KiCad |
| Consumables | hookup wire, resistors, LEDs, replaceable component samples, labels |
| Student deliverables | breadboard build, schematic, simulation, measurement plan, uncertainty statement |
